project_name: Arun Enterprises ERP - 3D Architectural Canvas Draft

visual_concept_3d.name: Architectural Isometric Stage & Layered Slab System
key_differentiators: Replaces generic tilt-cards with multi-layered Architectural Blueprint Slabs (layered elevation, backdrop blur, isometric angle controls).
Dual Theme Support (Crisp Architectural Light Mode with blueprint grid overlay + High-Contrast Tactical Slate Dark Mode).
Animated Micro-Interactions on Icons (Hover pulse, spring floating, gear rotation on System Mgmt, pulse beam on QC, counting effect on KPIs).
Interactive Stage Floor: 3D grid plane with glowing perspective lines and focal depth fog.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the home draft in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home3D.js with complete functionality.
Support dark and light mode toggle via standard React state / next-themes / class switching, retaining preference.
Header must display Arun Enterprises logo mark, official company name, tagline, active user greeting with role, pending approval badge, and theme switcher button.
Display 4 KPI stats cards with smooth 3D hover lift, live indicators, and data-testid attributes.

Display 10 department launcher tiles in an asymmetric responsive grid (3-4 columns on desktop). Each tile must feature an animated Lucide icon (framer-motion rotation, float, pulse, or tilt), department badge, descriptive subtitle, and explicit permission state (lock overlay when unauthorized).
Include an interactive 3D Architectural Blueprint Canvas section with isometric visual depth effects, subtle grid lines, depth parallax, and toggle controls for perspective mode.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='theme-toggle-button', data-testid='dept-tile-gm', data-testid='kpi-vendor-stat').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, toggles, cards, and input controls.
Maintain high APCA contrast ratios in both Light Mode (Dark Navy text on Off-White/Glass background) and Dark Mode (Crisp White/Sky Blue text on Dark Slate backdrop).
Never use full transparent backgrounds without backdrop blurs or solid fallbacks.
Use framer-motion spring animations for smooth non-linear 3D tile entrance and hover dynamics.
